Devolution Legal Questions: Scottish Secretary Douglas Alexander said: I am deeply saddened to learn of the passing of Jim Wallace. Jim was the kind of politician that gives politics a good name. Decent, thoughtful and dutiful he embodied much that is best in our national life. As Scotland’s first Deputy First Minister, he helped shape the very foundations of our devolved Parliament. His leadership during those early years set the tone for the institution we know today.
